title: Setting Up UPI
content: To use UPI, install a UPI app, register with the mobile number linked to the bank account, select the bank and set a UPI PIN using the debit card details and an OTP. The UPI PIN is secret; it is needed only to send money, never to receive money.

title: Money Sent to the Wrong Person
content: If money was sent to a wrong UPI ID or account, immediately raise a complaint in the UPI app and inform the bank with the transaction reference number. The bank will contact the receiver's bank, but the money can be returned only with the receiver's agreement, so recovery is not guaranteed.

title: NEFT, RTGS and IMPS
content: NEFT and IMPS work 24 hours on all days; IMPS is instant and NEFT is settled in half-hourly batches. RTGS is for amounts of Rs 2 lakh and above and is also real time. To send money, the receiver's account number and IFSC code are needed.

content: A gold loan is given by keeping gold jewellery with the bank. The amount depends on the weight and purity of the gold, up to the limit allowed by RBI. The gold is returned when the loan is repaid. Use the loan eligibility checker to see an estimate; staff confirm the final amount.

title: Insurance and Pension Schemes (PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY)
content: PMJJBY gives Rs 2 lakh life cover for Rs 436 a year (age 18-50). PMSBY gives Rs 2 lakh accident cover for Rs 20 a year (age 18-70). Atal Pension Yojana gives a monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after 60 (join between 18 and 40). Premiums are auto-debited from the savings account.

title: Branch Working Hours and Holidays
content: Branches of this demo bank are open from 10 am to 4 pm, Monday to Saturday. They are closed on Sundays, on the second and fourth Saturdays of the month, and on public holidays. ATMs, UPI and net banking work at all times.
